projectContext.name: Employee Onboarding Portal
projectContext.description: A multi-step onboarding wizard shows overlapping panels on 13" laptops and hides the primary Submit CTA on mobile Safari due to a sticky footer. The Markdown-rendered handbook displays raw HTML in dark mode and theme styles are inconsistent across steps.
projectContext.currentVersion: Production lacks responsive breakpoints for key layouts, conditional CTA rendering is brittle, and Markdown styling falls back to defaults in certain themes.
projectContext.targetVersion: Responsive_Onboarding_UI_v2 (consistent responsive layout, always-visible CTAs, robust Markdown rendering, and accessibility fixes)

issueStatement: Users report the onboarding wizard header overlaps the form on mid-size viewports, the Submit button is missing/covered on mobile Safari, and handbook content appears as raw HTML in dark mode. These UI regressions block completion and increase support tickets.
businessGoals: Ensure CTAs remain visible and reachable on all supported viewports (desktop, tablet, mobile Safari).
Fix layout overlap with proper responsive breakpoints and tested flex/grid behavior.
Render Markdown consistently (light/dark themes) with safe HTML sanitization and accessible typography.
Improve accessibility (ARIA, focus order, keyboard navigation) to reduce friction.

stack: Vite + React for UI; CSS Modules/Tailwind permitted.
Use a local mock API for profile and handbook content; no external services.
Capture visual regressions with Playwright or equivalent.

nonFunctional: Provide 5 UI integration test scenarios: desktop layout (no overlap), 13" laptop breakpoint, mobile Safari viewport with visible CTA, Markdown render in dark mode, and keyboard-only navigation. Runnable via a single script.
Emit structured UI interaction logs (no PII) with a unique session/request ID.
Deliver frontend page and redacted screenshots for the five scenarios.
